title: The Storyverse
description: A 26-second cinematic trailer that sets the tone for everything FrameVix stands for — mood, motion, and story in miniature. Built to be watched, re-watched, and felt.

title: Parallel
description: Two sides of an engineering student's life, told in parallel — the version they show the world, and the version they actually live.

title: The Notebook — Endgame
description: A story that closes the loop it opened. Every notebook has a last page — this is the one nobody wanted to write.

title: The Call
description: One of FrameVix's most acclaimed works — a slow-burn descent into horror and the psychology of fear itself. Answer only if you're ready.

title: Unfold
description: A mind-bending psychological short film that unravels the moment you think you've understood it. Nothing here stays folded for long.

title: We Escaped College for a Day
description: A cinematic trek documentary following one day of escape, freedom, and everything college doesn't teach you in a classroom.
